title: Jade-Face (玉面郎君) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Jade-Face (玉面郎君) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Jade-Face (玉面郎君) phantom blade zero boss

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The Lady's Shrine - temple ruins, north-west

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jade-Face (玉面郎君) is an optional encounter in Mountain of Imprisonment, found at The Lady's Shrine - temple ruins, north-west. Beating it yields Seamless Death.

sections.title: Where to Find the Jade-Face (玉面郎君)
sections.content:
Location: The Lady's Shrine - temple ruins, north-west.

Appears in: Mountain of Imprisonment.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Jade-Face (玉面郎君)
sections.content:
What works

  • He fights with two clones, so the arena holds three enemies at once - turn lock-on off and kill a clone first.
  • His teleport strings end in a parryable overhead or a two-handed slash; the blue flash on the final hit is the tell.
  • Punish the openings rather than forcing them; the reward is Seamless Death.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 49 of 60 in the progression order, in Mountain of Imprisonment. Before it: Kui Yanyan. After it: Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
